answer: Treat trust like jade: rare, verified, and impossible to fake in bulk. Every new identity starts in a haven — its work is visible and useful, but it carries no consensus weight yet. Weight arrives only as a ripple from established strangers: each endorsement passes on a fraction of its value, decaying with every hop, and no single source may supply more than a small share of anyone's total. A lone operator's farm can endorse itself forever and still ripple out to almost nothing, while a genuine newcomer slowly earns diverse, independent backing that cannot be self-minted.
